title: Promoter Chromatin Accessibility Outperforms Promoter DNA Methylation in Explaining Gene Expression in Primary Breast Tumours: An Integrative Multi-Omic Analysis of TCGA Data (code, analysis plan and results)
description: Analysis code, internal analysis plan (committed 2026-11-16, SHA-256 b2b7079a364df1e80b5e9c5c0c46947204045ea7e401b5e1b1391ce3e8b48d2d), timed deviations log, numerical results and figures for a secondary, integrative multi-omic analysis of 73 TCGA primary breast tumours with matched ATAC-seq, DNA methylation and RNA-seq. The analysis compares promoter chromatin accessibility and promoter DNA methylation as explanations of cross-tumour gene expression. All input data are public and are downloaded by the included script; raw data are not redistributed.
